items.question: Suppose Voss-Lindqvist had paid Harrowgate USD 300,000 in fees in the year before the event giving rise to a claim. Would each party's liability under the signed MSA still be capped at USD 250,000?
items.answer:
Under the Harrowgate MSA, each party's liability is capped at the greater of USD 250,000 or the Fees paid by the Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim [3].

The Harrowgate MSA's clause 4.1 states that the Client shall pay a platform subscription fee of USD 18,500 per month [1].

If Voss-Lindqvist had paid Harrowgate USD 300,000 in fees in the year before the event giving rise to a claim, the cap would be the greater of USD 250,000 or the Fees paid, which in this case would be USD 300,000. Therefore, the liability would not be capped at USD 250,000 but at USD 300,000.

evidence.quote: Each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of USD 250,000 or the Fees paid by Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim

items.question: Northbridge walks Voss-Lindqvist through its methodology on a video call and hands over nothing in writing. Can what was said still be Confidential Information under the NDA?
items.answer:
The Northbridge NDA defines "Confidential Information" in Clause 2.2. It states that Confidential Information includes all information disclosed by a Party (the "Discloser") to the other (the "Recipient") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential [7].

The NDA also specifies that Confidential Information does not include information that the Recipient can show (a) is or becomes public other than through a breach of the Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it before disclosure; (c) is independently developed without use of the Discloser's information; or (d) is lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidence [7].

Based on these terms, what was said during the video call could still be considered Confidential Information if it met the criteria outlined in Clause 2.2. Specifically, if the information was disclosed in connection with the Purpose and either was marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential, it would qualify as Confidential Information under the NDA. The fact that Northbridge handed over nothing in writing does not automatically exclude the information from being confidential, as the definition includes information that would reasonably be understood to be confidential.

evidence.quote: Confidential Information" means all information disclosed by a Party (the "Discloser") to the other (the "Recipient") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential

Confidential Information does not include information that the Recipient can show (a) is or becomes public other than through a breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it before disclosure; (c) is independently developed without use of the Discloser's information; or (d) is lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidence.
